audience: freelancers and small agencies that track time and bill clients in Paydirt

useCases.title: Review clients and their hourly rates
useCases.text: List the clients of the account with their billing details and hourly rates, then read one client.

useCases.title: Review unbilled time for a period
useCases.text: List time logs by date range, user, client or project, and filter for logs that are not billed yet.

useCases.title: Log time against a job
useCases.text: List the jobs, then log time on one job by start and end time, or by duration and date. The record is billable.

useCases.title: Set up a new client with a project and job
useCases.text: Create a client, a project under it and a job in that project. Each call creates a new record.

useCases.title: Mark a project or job complete
useCases.text: Rename a project or job, or mark it completed or open again.
